title: Pale Pink Dye
summary: Single-use dye gives compatible equipment a pale pink palette.

fields.Use: Combine it with eligible equipment in inventory to recolour it.
fields.Acquisition: Level 5+ traders such as Quartermaster Talli or Araj Oblodra.
fields.Base value: 6 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
